mechanisms.behavior: Initialize four balls at switches 18-21. The known-working Pro script orders the stack from exit switch 21 through 20, 19, and left switch 18, identifies it as a trough, ejects through output 1 at angle 90 and force 4, and pulses jam switch 22 during release.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: Output 2 fires the automatic plunger for a ball at shooter-lane switch 23. The proven impulse settings are power 50, duration 0.6, and randomness 1.5.
mechanisms.label: Auto launcher

mechanisms.behavior: The doors use a dual-winding power/hold coil. In the known-working Pro script, output 3 asserted opens both doors and clears switch 4; output 4 de-asserted closes them and sets switch 4. Switch 46 reports ball passage through the prison-door opto.
mechanisms.label: Dual prison doors

positions.description: Output 3 asserted; switch 4 inactive in the Pro script.
positions.label: Open

positions.description: Output 4 de-asserted; switch 4 active in the Pro script.
positions.label: Closed

mechanisms.behavior: Output 7 controls a radius-30 centered capture magnet. On release, balls within radius 15 receive a random full-circle direction and speed from 15 up to 20 before the magnet turns off.
mechanisms.label: Prison capture magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Targets 9-11 latch down and maintain their switches. Output 12 raises the complete bank through the VPX drop-target controller.
mechanisms.label: Left three-bank drop targets

mechanisms.behavior: The Well Walker is a spring-return target without the Premium/LE well magnet. Switch 2 initializes active at rest, clears on impact, and returns active when the target timer restores it.
mechanisms.label: Well Walker target

mechanisms.behavior: A ball hit pulses switch 3 and briefly deflects the spring-return Prison Walker figure before the table timer restores it.
mechanisms.label: Prison Walker bash target

mechanisms.behavior: Switches 30-32 pulse the corresponding pop-bumper mechanisms driven by outputs 9-11.
mechanisms.label: Three pop bumpers

mechanisms.behavior: Switches 26 and 27 pulse the left and right slingshot assemblies driven by outputs 13 and 14.
mechanisms.label: Left and right slingshots

mechanisms.behavior: SAM fast-flip inputs drive outputs 15 and 16. The normally-closed EOS contacts are exposed at PinMAME switches 83 (left) and 81 (right).
mechanisms.label: Lower flippers
